paper.title_en: Projection of massive and interacting conformal theories to the future null infinity
paper.abstract_en: On a four-dimensional, globally hyperbolic and asymptotically flat spacetime, we consider a real, linear, massive scalar field. Within the framework of perturbative algebraic quantum field theory and inspired by the principle of perturbative agreement, we regard the mass term in the underlying Lagrangian as an interaction potential. This allows us to construct the algebra of observables of the massive theory and, using a Møller map, to represent its elements as formal power series in the squared mass, with coefficients in the algebra of observables of a massless, conformally coupled scalar field. Following [DMP06], we use the bulk-to-boundary correspondence for the massless theory to project each coefficient to future null infinity $\mathscr{I}^+$.In four-dimensional Minkowski spacetime, we prove convergence of the projected series in the presence of an infrared cut-off and show that the global adiabatic limit exists but is trivial. We circumvent this obstruction by exploiting the time-slice axiom, which allows us to restrict our attention to observables localized in a causally convex neighbourhood containing a Cauchy hypersurface. Removing the cut-off locally yields a non-trivial limit and hence a bulk-to-boundary correspondence for the massive theory. We then extend our procedure to a self-interacting real scalar field. We represent interacting observables as formal power series in the coupling constant, with coefficients in the algebra of observables of a massless, conformally coupled scalar field. Each coefficient in the domain of the bulk-to-boundary map can thus be projected to future null infinity. As a concrete example, we apply this method to the stress-energy tensor of a massless scalar field with a quartic self-interaction, computing its projection up to first order in perturbation theory.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在渐近平坦时空与未来零无穷的框架下，用微扰代数量子场论研究大质量与自相互作用共形场的体-边界对应，涉及Møller映射、时间片公理与绝热极限等技术细节，理论深度与方法严谨性信号较强，与本索引的基础议题相关。
decision.title_zh: 大质量与相互作用共形理论到未来零无穷的投影
decision.abstract_zh: 在四维、整体双曲且渐近平坦的时空上，我们考虑一个实的、线性的、大质量标量场。在微扰代数量子场论框架内，并受微扰一致性原则启发，我们将底层拉格朗日量中的质量项视为一种相互作用势。这使我们能够构造大质量理论的观测量代数，并使用Møller映射将其元素表示为质量平方的形式幂级数，其系数取值于无质量、共形耦合标量场的观测量代数。遵循[DMP06]，我们利用无质量理论的体-边界对应，将每个系数投影到未来零无穷$\mathscr{I}^+$。在四维Minkowski时空中，我们证明在存在红外截断时投影级数的收敛性，并表明全局绝热极限存在但是平凡的。我们通过利用时间片公理来规避这一障碍，该公理允许我们将注意力限制在局域于包含一个Cauchy超曲面的因果凸邻域内的观测量。局域地移除截断会得到一个非平凡的极限，从而得到大质量理论的体-边界对应。随后我们将该程序推广到自相互作用实标量场。我们将相互作用观测量表示为耦合常数的形式幂级数，其系数取值于无质量、共形耦合标量场的观测量代数。体-边界映射定义域中的每个系数因此可以被投影到未来零无穷。作为一个具体例子，我们将该方法应用于带四次自相互作用的无质量标量场的应力-能量张量，在微扰论一阶计算其投影。
